input_leakage_contract.label_and_split_fields_use: entry_id, partition, label_group, and target_fingerprint_id used only for split/evaluation labels and nearest-neighbor label lookup, not as embedding features

limitations: Whole-sequence Swiss-Prot H5 coverage excludes TrEMBL/currently missing accessions and selected-PDB fallback sequences; unsupported rows are not imputed.
Nearest-neighbor label propagation uses no trained probe and no similarity threshold; abstention is inherited only from nearest out_of_scope train rows.
Per-entry rows with multiple available accessions use mean pooling across proteins, which is a tractable complex-level proxy but not active-site pooling.
Active-site pooling was not attempted and should remain a separate known_active_site_window_ablation under its own contract.

metadata.abstention_policy: abstain only when nearest in-distribution train row label_group is out_of_scope; no similarity threshold selected
metadata.active_site_pooling_note: not mixed with whole-sequence evidence budget; reserve for separate known_active_site_window_ablation
metadata.source_id: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot embeddings current_release uniprot_sprot/per-protein.h5; ProtT5/prottrans_t5_xl_u50 vectors

overlap_diagnostic_for_any_threshold_sep.threshold_selection_rule: no_similarity_threshold_selected; abstention occurs only when nearest train row label_group is out_of_scope

sequence_nn_baseline_comparison.comparison_note: ProtT5 metrics cover only heldout rows with at least one H5 accession embedding; missing-H5 heldout rows are reported separately.
